description: Get recent investor-relations press releases for a stock, scraped from the company's IR website. Returns the most recent news items (headline, publish date, summary when the source provides one, and link) in reverse-chronological order. Use this to see a company's latest official announcements straight from its IR page, distinct from third-party news. Coverage is partial — only companies whose IR page has been discovered and content-scraped have items, so an empty answer may be a coverage gap rather than corporate silence; the response says which case applies.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of news items to return (default: 20, max: 500)

offset.description: Number of matching news items to skip before returning rows (default: 0).

since.description: Optional earliest publish date, strict yyyy-MM-dd (UTC). Only items published on or after this date are returned.

name: GetInvestorRelationsNews
title: Investor Relations News
